title: World Bleeding Disorders Registry Pilot Study
brief_summary: The World Federation of Hemophilia (WFH) is conducting the pilot phase of an international, observational, World Bleeding Disorders Registry (WBDR). This pilot phase will assess the feasibility of conducting an expanded WBDR to more centres with a more comprehensive case report form, around the world.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients of participating Hemophilia Treatment Centres with Hemophilia A or B.
* Ability to provide data in English

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
study_population: Patients with Hemophilia A or B, who are patients of participating Hemophilia Treatment Centres.
